about: Spaces printed on the map sheets off the hex grid: the Axis Tripoli/Tunis off-map complex (8.8), the holding boxes for crowded hexes (4.26) and the Axis Mediterranean bases, and the Commonwealth off-map air facilities (36.5, chart 36.53). Each outline is in its section's scan pixels, as the hex grids are; 'rect' is [x, y, width, height]. 'hex' is the hex a holding box stands for.

zones.name: Tunis
zones.text: Axis off-map box with a port (Bizerta), air facilities and unlimited water; no stacking limit. Only Axis units and Commonwealth planes may enter the Tripoli/Tunisia boxes (8.82, 8.87).

zones.name: Gabes
zones.text: Axis off-map box with air facilities and unlimited water; no stacking limit (8.87).

zones.name: Tripoli
zones.text: The main Axis port of entry, with an Axis training area, air facilities and unlimited water; no stacking limit. Reinforcements and replacements arriving here may not move in their arrival OpStage (8.86, 8.87).

zones.name: Tripolitania
zones.text: The off-map box nearest the map. Units leave the map for it from hex A2802 and enter on the road hex closest to it (8.85).

zones.name: Sicily
zones.text: Axis Mediterranean air base (holding box). Axis Mediterranean bases may not be bombed (36.5).

zones.name: Italy
zones.text: Axis Mediterranean air base (holding box). Axis Mediterranean bases may not be bombed (36.5).

zones.name: Benghazi Holding Box
zones.text: Holds the counters in Benghazi (A4827) when the hex is crowded (4.26).

zones.name: Derna Holding Box
zones.text: Holds the counters in Derna (B5925) when the hex is crowded (4.26).

zones.name: Crete
zones.text: Mediterranean air base (holding box). British until the island falls; later an Axis base.

zones.name: Tobruk Holding Box
zones.text: Holds the counters in Tobruk (C4807) when the hex is crowded (4.26).

zones.name: Bardia Holding Box
zones.text: Holds the counters in Bardia (C4321) when the hex is crowded (4.26).

zones.name: Alexandria Holding Box (Hex 3613)
zones.text: Holds the counters in Alexandria hex E3613 (4.26).

zones.name: Alexandria Holding Box (Hex 3714)
zones.text: Holds the counters in Alexandria hex E3714 (4.26).
